description: This file contains assembly code for setting the SRAM clock rates on Realtek RTL839X hardware, including functions to start and set DRAM rates specific to the RTL839X chip, with conditional compilation for different configurations.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_start
methods.description: Entry point for starting DRAM clock operations; assembly label.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_set_rate
